strongest_verified_claim: On R^2, xi=lambda_1 tensor (sum_n delta_n + 2 sum_n delta_(n+1/2)), with constant X and law concentrated on phase 0, is diffuse and locally finite; every pointwise-equivariant xi-preserving measurable allocation fixes the rooted state, including arbitrary noninjective allocations, but the original mass-stationarity identity fails with event discrepancy 2/3.
exact_assumptions: G = R^2, an allowed locally compact second countable Hausdorff Abelian group.
The random measure is diffuse, nonzero, locally finite, and root-supported Q-a.s.; X is constant.
Allocations are measurable functions of the original observable state, pointwise covariant for every state and translation.
Spatial xi preservation may be required everywhere or Q-a.s.; noninjectivity is allowed.
No independent stationary background is adjoined.

checkable_witness.all_allocation_reduction: delta_[b0] + 2 delta_[1/2+b1] = delta_0 + 2 delta_1/2; unique solution b0,b1 integers

boundary_variants_not_claimed: Freeness or exclusion of invariant directions.
Spatial-a.e. covariance with an unconstrained root representative.
remaining_nonmathematical_gates: Novelty and priority were not established.
Publication and redistribution decisions remain with the parent workflow.
